style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, warm light
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window, props go in subordinate clauses. HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, and never leaves it. His legs stay in shot, no prop between his body and the lens, never facing the lens while talking. No window ends on an impact, a grip or a planted pose; a moving prop or a camera move alone never counts; new shot size every window
character: a plump velvet mole, tiny eyes, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty, grave
props: CALCULATOR: chunky cream plastic, BLANK buttons and BLANK screen. CHEST: a battered trunk with a loose iron ring that rings. BOOTS: two split boots. HAT: a crushed felt hat
prop_continuity: the calculator never lights up; the ringing comes from the earth and the chest ring; he shoves the calculator along the floor, never holds it up, never stands behind the chest
environment: inside a round burrow, roots overhead, packed soil floor
lighting: bright light from a hole above, dust motes lit, high exposure

audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec, never drawn out
audio.pacing: speech 0.6-3.4 and 4.2-6.5; voiceless after 6.5, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable
audio.sfx: a dry plastic click; one iron chime under the floor at 3.6, more spreading through the walls, the burrow ringing by 6.5; a wall caving in at 9.7

timeline.a: silent. He bursts out of the soil wall and lands running the whole frame, shoving the blank calculator along the floor, clods flying
he runs left to right past the lens in profile, driving the calculator along the floor, roots whipping over his back
he runs up the wall and round it head down, his body sweeping the frame bottom to top, the calculator under one arm
he drops off the wall and slides the whole width of the burrow on his back, stamping the big blank button in passing; nothing lights, the dead calculator skittering on ahead
silent. He hurls himself the whole width of the burrow onto solid soil as the floor rings and caves away behind his heels
he claws up the collapsing wall in two lunges, his body crossing the frame bottom to top, soil pouring past the lens
he loses the wall and tumbles head over heels across the floor edge to edge as the chime spreads through the walls
silent from now on. He tears into the floor and drives his whole body down through it, earth blasting into the lens
silent. He bursts out of the hole and runs the chest the whole width of the burrow ahead of him, ring clanging
silent. He tips the chest and dives across the frame through it as it rolls; split boots and a crushed hat spill over the floor
silent. He skids after the hat, jams it on and blunders across the frame, the brim over his eyes
silent. He dives the width of the frame onto the dead calculator and stamps that same button again; the wall caves in and buries the frame

must_appear: the calculator blank, the first chime from under the FLOOR not the device, boots and a crushed hat out of the chest, the hat over his eyes, him stamping that same button at the end
negative_prompt: black bands, speech bubble, caption box, digits, cyrillic, subtitles, a lit calculator screen, night, dim light, a rat, round ears, slow motion, a head-on medium shot, the calculator held up at his chest, him behind the chest, a prop covering his body, a static wide at the end, any voice after 6.5, drawn-out delivery
